pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: Phil Trobb, CFA, is preparing a purchase recommendation on Aneas Lumber for his research firm. Which of the following least likely represents a conflict of interest that Trobb should disclose in his report?
option_a: Trobb's research rm has a large stake of ownership in Aneas.
option_b: Trobb's cousin repairs machines for Aneas.
option_c: Aneas hires Trobb as a consultant to analyze Aneas' nancial statements.
explanation_en: Standard VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts defines what constitutes a conflict of interest with regard to clients, prospective clients, and employers. All of these represent potential conflicts of interest with the exception of the cousin working for Aneas Lumber in a job that is unrelated to the Aneas' financing.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: An analyst is serving on the Board of Directors of a local publicly traded company. To avoid violating the CFA Institute Code and Standards, the analyst must disclose this to:
option_a: both his employer and his clients and prospective clients.
option_b: no one since it should not cause a conict of interest for the analyst.
option_c: only his employer.
explanation_en: Serving on a Board of Directors should be disclosed to both the employer and clients and prospective clients.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: Samuel Goldstein, CFA, is an analyst for Tamarack Securities. Goldstein's father, Reuben, has a client account at Tamarack. In ordering trades, Goldstein should place orders in:
option_a: all accounts simultaneously.
option_b: his clients' accounts first, his father's account second, and his account last.
option_c: his clients' and his father's accounts in the first group and his personal accounts in the second group.
explanation_en: Standard VI(B), Priority of Transactions, provides that transactions for clients have priority over personal trades. Family accounts that are considered client accounts receive the same treatment as client accounts.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: Ryan Brown, CFA, is an analyst with a large insurance company. His personal portfolio includes a significant investment in QRS common stock. The director of the research department asked Brown to analyze QRS and write a report about its investment potential. Based on the Standards of Professional Conduct, Brown is required to:
option_a: decline to write the report.
option_b: sell his shares of QRS before issuing the report.
option_c: disclose the ownership of the stock in the report.
explanation_en: Standard VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts requires that Brown make full disclosure of all matters that could impair his objectivity. Brown needs to disclose his personal holding in QRS stock. Neither of the other choices describes an action that the Standard requires.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: According to Standard VI(A), Disclosures of Conflicts, members must disclose to their clients the member's (or their firm's) material ownership of all of the following EXCEPT:
option_a: benecial ownership of securities.
option_b: real estate holdings.
option_c: corporate nance relationships.
explanation_en: Unless the firm's real estate holdings would impair their independence and objectivity, they need not be disclosed.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: An analyst likes to trade commodity futures in her own account. She does not deem any of her client accounts suitable for commodity futures trading. When she identifies a favorable commodity futures position, the Standard concerning priority of transactions suggests she should:
option_a: act on it on her own behalf as she sees t.
option_b: rst tell her clients about it before acting herself.
option_c: refrain from acting until she noties her supervisor.
explanation_en: The analyst's commodity futures trading is not a violation of Standard VI(B) Priority of Transactions because the investment is not suitable for her clients. If the analyst believes that none of her clients should trade commodity futures, she is not obligated to advise them of her own investments in them.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: Standard VI(C), Referral Fees, requires the member to do all of the following EXCEPT:
option_a: disclose to the referred client how much the referral source was paid to refer the client.
option_b: disclose to the referred client the percentage of the member's business that comes from referrals.
option_c: make required disclosures to the referred client before an agreement is made to provide services to the referred client.
explanation_en: The applicable Standard, VI(C), does not require a member to disclose the percentage of their business that comes from referrals. Standard VI(C) states, "Members shall disclose to clients and prospects any consideration or benefit received by the member or delivered to others for the recommendation of any services to the client or prospect." Appropriate disclosure means telling the client or prospect, before agreeing to perform services, of any benefit given or received for recommending the member's services.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: Referral fees a member must disclose to a prospective client include:
option_a: only fees a member receives for referrals.
option_b: only fees a member pays to others for referrals.
option_c: both fees a member receives and fees a member pays.
explanation_en: Members and candidates must disclose all referral arrangements to their employer, clients, and prospective clients.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: A firm produces regular proprietary research reports on various companies. According to Standard VI(B), Priority of Transactions, which of the following would be an "access person"?
option_a: An independent auditor with access to material, non-public information on a company being analyzed.
option_b: A person working in the mail room.
option_c: A supervisory analyst who reviews all research reports prior to dissemination.
explanation_en: Persons with access to information during the normal preparation of research recommendations are subject to Standard VI(B). An independent auditor is not involved in the normal preparation of research recommendations.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: Harry Lee, CFA, is an equity research analyst for a long-term investment fund. His annual bonus is linked to the fund's three-year average gains. Under a new policy, the bonus criterion is changed to include a link to the fund's quarterly trading profits. According to the Code and Standards, best practices dictate:
option_a: updating disclosures when the policy change is implemented.
option_b: requiring Hurst to obtain permission from each client prior to implementation of the new policy.
option_c: treating the policy change as proprietary information.
explanation_en: Standard VI(A) Disclosures of Conflicts recognizes this policy as a potential conflict of interest as members and candidates could be incentivized to favor short-term trading gains over long-term value creation. Best practices dictate updating disclosures when the policy change is implemented. The long-term investors should know how members and candidates are compensated, especially when there is the potential for conflicts of interest.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: An analyst who is a member of CFA Institute has composed an introductory information packet for her new clients, which includes information on fees she receives for referring clients to other professionals and those she pays for having clients referred to her. With respect to Standard VI(C), Referral Fees, this action:
option_a: exceeds the requirement of the Standard because she does not need to reveal the fees she pays to those that refer clients to her.
option_b: is not addressed in the Standard.
option_c: may not satisfy the Standard if such information is only provided after the receivers of the information have become clients.
explanation_en: Standard VI(C) says that a member must reveal information both on fees she receives for referring clients to other professionals and those she pays for having clients referred to her before a prospect becomes a client. This allows the prospect to evaluate any partiality of a recommendation and the full cost of the services.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: Rochester Frankfurt is a market maker in the stock of Byrne Brands, Inc. The chairman of Rochester Frankfurt serves on the board of directors of Byrne Brands. If an analyst at Rochester Frankfurt who is a CFA charterholder makes an investment recommendation on Byrne Brands, which of these two facts is the analyst required to disclose?
option_a: Neither of these facts.
option_b: Both of these facts.
option_c: Only one of these facts.
explanation_en: Both of these are examples of potential conflicts of interest that Standard VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts requires members or candidates to disclose.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: An analyst has been covering a particular firm for years. Recently, the analyst's uncle died and left the analyst a sizable position in the firm's stock. To comply with the Code and Standards, the analyst:
option_a: is required to disclose the ownership of the stock to his employer.
option_b: should divest the stock as soon as is practicable.
option_c: is not required to act because the analyst did not purchase the stock.
explanation_en: The analyst is required to disclose the ownership of the stock to his employer by Standard VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts. The analyst must also disclose the stock ownership in any subsequent coverage of the company. The Standard does not require or recommend that the analyst divest the stock.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.8 Guidance for Standard VI - Answers.pdf
question_en: The Standard concerning referral fees is applicable to:
option_a: only considerations received for recommending products or services.
option_b: any consideration received or paid for recommending products or services.
option_c: only considerations paid for recommending products or services.
explanation_en: Standard VI(C) Referral Fees requires members and candidates to disclose any consideration received or paid for a recommendation.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.9 Guidance for Standard VII - Answers.pdf
question_en: An analyst has not paid his CFA Institute dues for several years but has filed a professional conduct statement annually. Which of the following statements regarding his status with CFA Institute is most accurate? The analyst:
option_a: may not use the CFA designation.
option_b: is still considered an active member of CFA Institute.
option_c: may not refer to having been a CFA charterholder.
explanation_en: Standard VII(B) Reference to CFA Institute, the CFA Designation, and the CFA Program, applies. To remain an active member and maintain the right use the CFA designation, the member must pay annual dues and submit a yearly Professional Conduct Statement. Nothing in the Standard prohibits factual references to one's past status as a CFA charterholder.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.9 Guidance for Standard VII - Answers.pdf
question_en: All of the following are required for a CFA Institute member to maintain his or her active status EXCEPT:
option_a: Passing each exam in no more than two tries.
option_b: paying membership dues to CFA Institute on an annual basis.
option_c: remit a completed Professional Conduct Statement on an annual basis.
explanation_en: Passing each exam in two or fewer tries is not required to maintain active status as a member of the CFA Institute. CFA Institute imposes both of the other choices.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.9 Guidance for Standard VII - Answers.pdf
question_en: Julie Stades retired several years ago and relinquished her membership in CFA Institute. She had the CFA designation up until then. She has decided to go back to work and puts the following statement on her resume: "I earned the CFA designation 10 years ago." Is this a violation of Standard VII(B)?
option_a: Yes, because she is no longer an active member.
option_b: No, as long as she does not indicate she currently has the designation.
option_c: Yes, she must state that she no longer holds the CFA designation.
explanation_en: Stades is allowed to state that she earned the designation as long as she does not infer that she currently has the designation.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.9 Guidance for Standard VII - Answers.pdf
question_en: For the past 5 years, Karen Beckworth, CFA, has served as a proctor for the CFA exam. Beckworth tells her assistant, a Level III CFA candidate, that she normally receives the examinations on the Thursday before the exam. Given the low pass rate at Level III, Beckworth asks her assistant if he would like an advance copy of the next exam. Beckworth's assistant declines the offer. Beckworth's assistant has been very vocal about expressing his opinions about the low pass rate. The assistant claims, "there are too many charterholders and CFA Institute is deliberately failing candidates because the prestige of the CFA charter is becoming diluted." With regard to Standard VII(A) Conduct as Participants in CFA Institute Programs, which of the following statements concerning Beckworth's and her assistant's behavior is most accurate?
option_a: Neither Beckworth nor her assistant is in violation of Standard VII(A).
option_b: Both Beckworth and her assistant are in violation of Standard VII(A).
option_c: Beckworth is in violation of Standard VII(A), but her assistant is not in violation.
explanation_en: Beckworth is in violation of Standard VII(A), Conduct as Participants in CFA Institute Programs. Beckworth compromised the integrity of the exam by offering her assistant an advance copy. Beckworth's assistant is allowed to express his opinion without violation of any Standards.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.9 Guidance for Standard VII - Answers.pdf
question_en: Stephanie Irons, a Level II CFA candidate, regularly posts in internet chat rooms dedicated to candidates studying for the Level II exam. Throughout the season, she and other candidates discuss curriculum content in great detail. Three days after her exam window ends, she returns to the site and vents her frustrations over complicated exam questions by posting questions she remembers on the site, and asking others for their responses and reasoning. Other candidates follow suit and post the questions they remember. Irons and her fellow candidates are most likely:
option_a: in violation of the Code and Standards for discussing curriculum content in a public forum prior to the exam.
option_b: not in violation because the information about the actual exam contents was posted after the close of the exam window.
option_c: in violation of the Code and Standards for providing confidential information about the exam.
explanation_en: Standard VII(A) Conduct as Participants in CFA Institute Programs prohibits members and candidates from providing confidential information about the exam even after the conclusion of the exam.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 91.9 Guidance for Standard VII - Answers.pdf
question_en: John Johnson, portfolio manager at Sunshine Investments, has passed all three levels of the CFA® Program and has completed his work experience requirements. He expects to receive his charter in the near future. He includes the following statement in his firm's brochure: "Johnson has passed all three levels of the exam and has completed the required work experience for the CFA Charter. He is eligible for the CFA Charter and expects to receive the charter in the near future. Over the years, he has demonstrated a superior performance and his CFA Charter will be rightfully awarded." Johnson has:
option_a: not violated CFA Institute Standards of Professional Conduct because he met all disclosure requirements.
option_b: violated CFA Institute Standards of Professional Conduct because he advertised the CFA Charter before actually obtaining it.
option_c: violated CFA Institute Standards of Professional Conduct because he implied superior performance that would be linked to the CFA Charter.
explanation_en: According to Standard VII(B), Reference to CFA Institute, the CFA Designation, and the CFA Program, Johnson may indicate that he has completed the requirements and is eligible for the CFA charter along with an accurate explanation of the requirements. However, he may not imply that the designation would mean superior performance capabilities.
